_why: M1 task 1.3 (2026-10-09): the one sentence under the evidence beat's 'Cited {subject}' table that names the brand's confirmed other sites. Read by test_other_sites_report.py and derive.test.ts alike so the PDF and the web print the same sentence for the same input. 'rows' is the report's proof.subjectOtherSites, already in the API's order (most cited first, then domain); 'expected' is null where nothing is printed. 'emptyMessages': the 'Cited {subject}' table's empty message when the client's own domain was not cited but a confirmed other site was (the old sentence would be untrue); null leaves each surface's existing sentence.

cases.subject: RMIT University
cases.expected: RMIT University's other sites: rmit.edu.vn — 4 citations

cases.subject: RMIT University
cases.expected: RMIT University's other sites: rmit.edu.vn — 1 citation

cases.case: several are joined with a semicolon in the order given
cases.subject: RMIT University
cases.expected: RMIT University's other sites: rmit.edu.vn — 4 citations; rmit.edu.sg — 1 citation; rmit.university — 2 citations
